我的生活与城市生活(My Life and city life): 一篇关于城市生活的A2短文:杰克与利奥的经历和小计划。
Last Tuesday, Jack and Leo went to the bus terminal. Leo's birthday is in December. There are always many people at the city library. The light rail crosses the river twice.
Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like dumplings and tea. Best of all, the business trip spans three cities.
Jack usually has dumplings for breakfast. They took many photos at the city library. Jack's favorite animal is the elephant. For example, a blue door marks their townhouse.
Leo is interested in dancing. Life is full of small surprises. The bus terminal is one of the best places in the city.
